name: GHK-Cu

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: A naturally occurring tripeptide that chelates copper(II), used topically as a cosmetic ingredient and injected without approval. Topical cosmetic use is regulated as a cosmetic, not as a drug; there is no FDA-approved injectable product. Cosmetic ingredient status for topical use. No FDA-approved injectable product exists.

systems.note: Taken for dermal and connective-tissue remodelling; the intended effect.
Injected use delivers a copper load with no approved dosing reference.

monitors.why: The compound delivers copper; a copper load is the specific, distinguishing concern.
Copper accumulates hepatically and there is no approved injectable dosing reference.
